column1: # Generic leak rules for scan.py (this folder), run by
# .github/workflows/secret-scan.yml on every pull request and push to main,
# next to gitleaks. Columns, tab-separated: id, kind, severity, pattern,
# description. kind: regex (content), name (file path), ipv4 (literals inside
# the comma-separated CIDRs). severity: fail, or secret (fail and redact).
# Accepted hits go in scan-allow.tsv, each with a reason.
